title: GEO vs SEO: What Changes and What Stays the Same
excerpt: How GEO and SEO differ, what they share, what the ranking and AI citation data says, and how to split your time, with worked examples, measurement and a 90-day plan.

meta.rl_answer: SEO ranks your pages in a list of results. GEO gets your brand named or cited inside an AI written answer. They share one foundation: crawlable, useful, trusted pages. What changes is the result (a mention, not a position), the measures, and the weight of other sites. For most businesses, do SEO first, add GEO habits on top and measure both in one report.
meta.rl_takeaways:
SEO aims for a rank and a click. GEO aims for a mention or citation inside an AI answer.
Google says AI features have no extra technical requirements beyond Search, so SEO is the base.
Ahrefs found cited pages that also rank in the top 10 fell from about 76% (July 2025) to about 38% (March 2026), so ranking helps but is not enough.
Pew found people clicked a result in 8% of visits with an AI summary against 15% without one.
Run one report with two sections: rankings and clicks, plus monthly prompt tests of 15 to 25 buyer questions.
Pick the channel where your buyers act: local and buy searches lean SEO, comparison questions add GEO and PR.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is the difference between GEO and SEO? | SEO improves your site so it ranks in search results and earns clicks. GEO improves your content and brand so AI tools mention or cite you in the answers they write. They share the same foundation of crawlable, useful, trusted pages.
Is GEO replacing SEO? | No. Google says AI features have no extra technical requirements beyond Search, and SEO remains the base. GEO adds habits for AI answers and a new way to measure.
Do I need to rank in Google to be cited by AI? | Ranking helps but is not required. Ahrefs found that about 38% of pages cited in Google AI Overviews ranked in the top 10 in March 2026, down from about 76% in July 2025, so pages that rank elsewhere or not at all are also cited.
Why did the overlap between rankings and AI citations change? | Ahrefs suggests that query fan-out plays a bigger role, so AI answers cite pages that appear for related sub-questions. Google does not publish fan-out queries, so this is an informed guess, not a confirmed cause.
Should I run GEO and SEO as one program? | In most cases yes. They share one technical and editorial base, and separate teams can publish pages that compete with each other. You do need a GEO measurement method on top of normal SEO tools.
How is GEO measured differently from SEO? | SEO uses rankings, clicks and conversions. GEO uses monthly prompt tests of real buyer questions to track mentions, citations, cited pages and competitors, plus referral visits from AI tool domains and brand accuracy.
Do AI answers reduce clicks? | Pew found that Google users clicked a result link in 8% of visits when an AI summary appeared and 15% when it did not, and clicked a link inside the summary in 1% of visits. That study covers Google in March 2025 for 900 US adults.
Does AI traffic convert better than organic traffic? | Ahrefs reported a large lift on its own site, but that is one company and another study it cites found that not every site sees it. Measure the conversion rate of AI referral visits on your own site.
Which should a local business focus on? | Local businesses usually lean on SEO and local SEO because searches such as near me and emergency still send people to maps and pages. Add GEO for advice questions where you have real expertise.
Do I need llms.txt or special markup for GEO? | Google says it does not use llms.txt files and that no special markup is needed for its AI features. Some other services may read them. Fix your pages, access and brand facts first.

meta.rl_g_glossary:
GEO | Generative engine optimization: making your content easy for AI tools to find and quote.
SEO | Search engine optimization: improving your site so it ranks in search results.
Query fan-out | One question split into several related searches to build a fuller answer.
Citation | A link or named source shown with an AI answer.
Share of voice | The share of answers that name your brand out of all tracked answers.
Zero-click search | A search where the person gets what they need without clicking a result.
